## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who runs into it, and when?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Be as concrete as you can — a sketch of the UI,
API shape, or user flow helps.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't go with them.

## Additional context

Check [PRD.md](../../PRD.md) for current phasing and non-goals before
proposing — anything touching wallets, custody, secret keys, or fiat/KYC is
out of scope regardless of phase.
